verdict.rationale: Lithic explicitly documents a sandbox environment that mirrors production for running cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end, with dedicated endpoints to simulate acquirer-originated transactions, and the MCP/blog materials describe an AI agent creating test cards, configuring rules, and running transactions against them in this sandbox. This directly matches the story of AI-native testing without touching production data.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs, and explicit statement that sandbox data is fully isolated from production billing/data stores.
